case.title: Follow-up 'any update??' on an existing thread
case.subject: Re: Google Calendar not syncing
case.text:
any update??

On Mon, 16 Nov 2026 at 10:12, Slotwise Support <support@slotwise.test> wrote:
> Thanks Tom, we're looking into the sync issue and will get back to you.
case.why: Almost no content of its own; context lives in the quoted thread. A chaser deserves review (and a bump in urgency), not a generic auto-reply or a promise of a fix date.

output.reply:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for following up, and sorry for the wait. I don't have an update on your case yet, and I can't give a timeline, but a teammate will follow up with you directly.

In the meantime, here are some things you can try. Go to Profile → Calendar sync, click Disconnect, then Connect Google Calendar again, and allow both permissions (view and edit events). Also check that the time zone in Settings → Business details matches your Google Calendar.

If sync still fails, please reply with the staff member's name and an example appointment so our team can check the sync log. You can also check live status of calendar sync at status.slotwise.test.

Slotwise Support
